items.title: Pakistan Shaheens cruise into Asia Cup Rising Stars final with five-wicket win over Bangladesh ‘A’
items.description:
Pakistan Shaheens produced a composed five-wicket victory over Bangladesh ‘A’ in the second semi-final of the Asia Cup Rising Stars on Friday, chasing down a target of 233 with 28 balls to spare to book their place in Sunday’s final against Sri Lanka ‘A’.
The defending champions reached 233-5 in 45.2 overs after Bangladesh ‘A’ had posted 232-8 in their 50 overs. Hasan Nawaz, who made 62 and claimed two wickets, was named player of the match.
The chase was shaped by a measured third-wicket partnership between Hasan and Shahzaib Khan, who steadied the innings after Pakistan had lost both openers

items.description:
A meeting of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement’s top decision-making body on Friday reviewed the regional security situation and condemned “persistent and heinous” Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.

items.title: President Zardari, PML-Q chief Shujaat discuss country's political situation
items.description:
President Asif Ali Zardari on Friday discussed the country’s political situation in a meeting with former prime minister and Pakistan Muslim League-Quaid (PML-Q) chief Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain.
In a statement, the Presidency said that President Zardari held the meeting with Shujaat at the latter’s residence in Lahore, where Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi was also present.
“National affairs and the political situation were discussed during the meeting,” the statement said.
The president wished the PML-Q leader a speedy recovery, it added.

items.description:
KARACHI: A man buried under the rubble from the collapse of an under-construction six-storey building near Karachi’s Baloch Colony was rescued alive on Friday, two days after the incident occurred.
On Wednesday, three people were killed and 14 others injured when the under-construction building — reportedly being constructed illegally on a residential plot — collapsed. items.description:

items.title: Short-term inflation clocks in at 9.49pc driven by wheat flour prices
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: Short-term inflation was recorded at 9.49 per cent year-on-year in the week ending on Nov 26, driven largely by wheat flour prices, according to official data released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS) on Friday.
The index comprises 51 items, with prices collected from 50 markets in 17 cities, and is calculated weekly to track changes in the prices of essential commodities and services.
The data showed that the prices of 20 commodities increased, while those of nine items declined. Meanwhile, the prices of 22 items remained unchanged from the previous week.

items.description:
Airline Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian operating unit has declared bankruptcy, the long-haul budget carrier said on Friday, succumbing to soaring fuel costs wrought by the war on Iran.

items.title: ADB approves $468m in loans to boost water, agriculture management in KP and Punjab
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) on Friday approved two loans totalling $468 million to improve water and agriculture management in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Punjab.
According to the bank, the financing will strengthen community resilience to shocks related to the changing climate, boost rural livelihoods and enhance food security for about 728,000 people.
